The above activities will be tailored to meet the objectives of the arban renewal plan. In brief, these objectives are (1) to minimize or neutralize the effects of any future flooding by complying with Federal, State and local requirements regarding areas subject to flooding (this includes a commitment by the locality to adopt flood plain ordinances). (2) correct or compensate for physical damage to both private and public property, and to (3) generally upgrade the area with regard to *ssential neighborhood services, private property rehabilitation, traffic control, parking, utilities, open spaces, recreation, shopping, etc. Although item (3) above may be in addition to the direct needs of the community to recover from the storm damage, these additional activities are viewed as necessary due to the wehicle by which assistance is given the community, i.e., artan renewal. These items are necessary to protect the Federal investment in the area provided under items (1) and (2) and are consistent with urban renewal practices allowed under Title I of the Housing Act of 1949.
